headline: MEDIDA EXTREMA POR FINANCIAL PROBLEMS OF THE DERRAMA FOR RETIRED TEACHERS
content: Through Resolution SBS No. 134–2016 dated January 11, 2016, the Superintendent of Banking, Insurance, and Private Administrators of Pension Funds declared the dissolution and initiation of liquidation proceedings for the Retirement Fund for Teachers – DERSEE under powers granted by Law No. 26616, amended by Laws Nos. 29532 and 26702 – which establishes the General Financial System and Insurance Regulations along with amendments to the Organic Regulation of Bank Supervision and its modifications, pursuant to Article 150 of the regulation approved through Resolution SBS No. 8504–2010 dated August 6, 2010. The reason behind such measure was due to the expiration of the Intervention Period established by Resolution SBS No. 6167–2015 dated October 12, 2015, extended further by Resolution SBS No. 7186–2015 dated November 25, 2015, during which time there had been no presentation of a feasible restructuring plan capable of overcoming the financial issues faced by DERSEE prompting adoption of these exceptional measures. It should also be noted that while within the intervention period three proposals were received twice over regarding the entity’s restructuring or revitalization plans, said plans lacked necessary elements making them non-viable regardless, additionally failing to observe formalities outlined in Article 130 of the regulations. Consequently, given protection of members’ interests, it has been decided to declare DERSEE dissolved initiating their liquidation process; henceforth, DERSEE in Liquidation shall cease member contribution deductions concerning funds but maintain deduction solely pertaining outstanding credit payments. DERSEE in Liquidation will announce shortly about procedures related to obligation settlements, set to occur at National Bank offices following precedence rules stipulated by current legislation.

headline: MATO A PUÑALADAS A SU PAREJA EN NAVIDAD
content: CONDENAN A 28 AₓOS DE CRUEL AL HIOMICIDA Se hizo justicia. El Juzgado Penal Colegiado Supraprovincial de Piura conden ayer a 28 aₓos de cruel a Emiliano Fernando Vasquez Acevedo por el asesinato de su pareja, Fanny Zoraida Ruiz Herrera, ocurrido en la ciudad de Sechura. El poder judicial preciso que Vasquez Acevedo le quit la vida a su conviviente el pasado 25 de diciembre propinandole 29 punaladas en el cuerpo.
